document.title: Cofacilitator companion clinical entry for family session HG-E104

relations.quote: Accompanying clinical entry for the family appointment facilitated with Mara Voss.
The agreed home practice and ongoing treatment plan are recorded in Mara Voss's primary note for HG-E104.

quotes: Participants: Rowan Mercer and Casey Mercer; both present for the full 45 minutes
Author: Leena Park, LPC, cofacilitator with Mara Voss, LCSW

observations.statement: Rowan initially described partner reminders as evidence of falling behind.
observations.quote: Rowan initially described partner reminders as evidence that they were falling behind.

observations.statement: Casey explained reminders were meant to help but acknowledged repeated prompts increased tension.
observations.quote: Casey explained that the reminders were an attempt to help, while also recognizing that repeated prompts increased tension.

observations.statement: Rowan was able to reflect Casey's wish for reassurance that preparation was happening.
observations.quote: Rowan was able to state that Casey wanted reassurance that some preparation was happening.

observations.statement: The communication rehearsal became less defensive with repetition.
observations.quote: The rehearsal became less defensive with repetition.

observations.statement: Both participants contributed ideas for a brief, predictable check-in.
observations.quote: Both participants contributed ideas for a brief, predictable check-in.

observations.statement: Rowan found a shared evening walk more acceptable than a lengthy review of unfinished tasks.
observations.quote: Rowan said this felt more acceptable than a lengthy review of unfinished tasks.
